title: Consumer Protection Act, 2019
gazette_ref: The Gazette of India, Extraordinary, Part II, Sec. 1 - Consumer Protection Act, 2019 (No. 35 of 2019), assented 9 Aug 2019. Text as enacted; later amendments and the Rules made under it are not included. Marginal notes of the gazette are interleaved with the text.
notes: Pecuniary limits in sections 34, 47 and 58 are as enacted. The Central Government can prescribe other values, and the Consumer Protection (Jurisdiction of the District Commission, the State Commission and the National Commission) Rules, 2021 later prescribed different limits - those Rules prevail over the figures in this text.

title: Right to Information Act, 2005

notes: Text reprinted in a 2008 government handbook, so amendments made after 2008 (for example the Right to Information (Amendment) Act, 2019, which changed the tenure, salary and service conditions of Information Commissioners in sections 13 and 16) are not reflected. The first Schedule and chapter headings are omitted. Check the current text on the India Code before relying on it.

title: Right to Information (Regulation of Fee and Cost) Rules, 2005
gazette_ref: Right to Information (Regulation of Fee and Cost) Rules, 2005, G.S.R. 336 dated 16 Sept 2005 (Gazette of India, Extraordinary, 1 Oct 2005), as printed in Annexure XIV of the National Archives of India RTI Handbook (2008). Government reprint, not the gazette.
notes: Rule 4(d) as printed here was substituted by the 27 Oct 2005 amendment (G.S.R. 649(E)): inspection is free for the first hour and Rs 5 for each subsequent hour, not each fifteen minutes. Rules 3-5 also accept an Indian Postal Order (G.S.R. 294(E), 2006). The Central Government later issued the Right to Information Rules, 2012, which may prescribe different procedures; this is not a substitute for them. These Rules apply to Central Government public authorities - Maharashtra public authorities follow the Maharashtra Rules.

title: Right to Information (Regulation of Fee and Cost) Amendment Rules, 2005 and 2006

gazette_ref: Right to Information (Regulation of Fee and Cost) Rules, 2005, G.S.R. 336 dated 16 Sept 2005 (Gazette of India, Extraordinary, 1 Oct 2005), as printed in Annexure XIV of the National Archives of India RTI Handbook (2008). Government reprint, not the gazette.
notes: Amends the 2005 Central fee rules. For inspection of records, the amended rule 4(d) (Rs 5 for each subsequent hour) replaces the original wording.
